title: ingest.vault.changed payload (v2, closed)
description: Payload of ingest.vault.changed. Producer: app/watcher/registry.py::_emit_watch_event via insert_object_and_outbox (vault_path/relative_path/mtime/hash/watcher plus trace_id/event). Consumer: handle_ingest_vault_changed via _note_path_from_payload, so a non-empty vault_path or relative_path is required. Closed contract (#5704): undeclared top-level fields are rejected; producer extras belong under `extensions`. v1 stays registered for rows already tagged `ingest.vault.changed.v1`.

event_id.description: Envelope event id the worker run() loop copies into the payload before dispatch; carried onto retries.

_worker_retry_enqueued_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the worker retry enqueue.

extensions.description: The only open extension point: producer-specific extras must be nested here, never added as undeclared top-level fields.
